description: Service invoiced from abroad but supplied by a supplier established in the State (no reverse charge)
notes: VATCA 2010 s.12(1)(a) turns on the supplier being established outside the State. A person recorded the establishment: this supplier invoices from a US address but is established in the State, so the reverse charge does not apply and the supplier charges Irish VAT itself (EU Reg 282/2011 arts.10-11; the establishment test is multi-factor and stays flagged for guidance).

transaction.description: US-invoiced software subscription from an Irish-established supplier
